title: Undo uses up its history entry but doesn't revert the checklist
why: Undo looks like it worked: the button disables and the board re-renders. The snapshot it restored had already been changed by the edit it was meant to undo.
finding: `SET_CHECK_ITEM` sets `item.done` in place, and `snapshot()` only shallow-copies cards. A logpoint at `boardReducer.js:55` returned `sharedItemObject: true`: the saved past state and the live board shared the same checklist item.
actual: The Undo button in the board header consumed a history entry (its state flipped from enabled to disabled), but the board it was supposed to revert did not change: the Review card "Customer interview synthesis" still displays checklist badge "☑ 1/2" instead of being restored to "☑ 0/2". The undo action fired yet produced no visible revert of the checklist edit.
expected: Clicking "↶ Undo" in the board header should revert the last board mutation — the checklist edit — so the Review-column card "Customer interview synthesis" badge is restored to "☑ 0/2" (its pre-edit state), while consuming that one history entry.

chronology.text: After clicking Undo, the board re-rendered but the "Customer interview synthesis" card still shows badge "☑ 1/2", and the Undo button is now disabled (its history entry was consumed) — the checklist edit was not reverted.

reproduce.text: Open the Review-column card whose checklist has zero of two items done
Toggle the checkbox of the first checklist item
Click the Undo control in the board header

rootCause.text: The undo snapshot shares the very object that SET_CHECK_ITEM mutates. In http://localhost:3203/src/store/boardReducer.js the SET_CHECK_ITEM case (lines 48-56) finds the checklist item and writes `item.done = action.done` directly onto the existing item object, then records the pre-edit cards into `state.past` via record() -> history.js snapshot(). But snapshot() only shallow-copies each card (`{ ...card }`), so the recorded past snapshot shares the same checklist item objects as the live state. When the checkbox is toggled, the in-place mutation writes through to the snapshot that was just stored in state.past. The Logpoint at boardReducer.js:55 confirms this: the past snapshot's first checklist item is already `done: true` AND `sharedItemObject: true` (past snapshot item === current card item). When Undo then dispatches UNDO (boardReducer.js:86-91) it restores `cards: state.past[state.past.length - 1]` — which already contains `done: true` — so the badge stays "☑ 1/2" even though the past entry is consumed and the Undo button becomes disabled.

rootCauseSteps.text: Toggling the checklist checkbox dispatches SET_CHECK_ITEM, which in boardReducer.js mutates the existing checklist item in place (item.done = action.done, lines 48-56) and stores a snapshot of the cards into state.past; because history.js snapshot() shallow-copies cards ({ ...card }, lines 3-5), that stored snapshot shares the same (now-mutated) checklist item object — the Logpoint at boardReducer.js:55 returns pastDone [true, false] and sharedItemObject true for the "Customer interview synthesis" card.

Clicking Undo dispatches UNDO which restores cards from state.past[state.past.length-1] and slices the past entry; since the restored snapshot already contains done:true, the Review card badge stays "☑ 1/2" while the history entry is consumed — the Evaluate at the final frame returns undoDisabled:true and the badge text "☑ 1/2" still present.
